title: Labeled Novel Openings — full data log
description: Rare opening moves Stockfish rates sound, across ~63 tabiyas both colors, ranked strongest→weakest. Every move sourced from the Lichess explorer + chess.js (no invention); every finalist re-verified at ~depth 30 from the armed side after the opponent's best reply. White floor: eval>=0. Black floor: eval>=-0.45 (sound surprise).

legend.verifyEval: engine eval from the ARMED side's view after opponent's best reply (the real result)
legend.sideToMove: w = White weapon, b = Black weapon
legend.freqPct: how often humans play this move at the node (the rarity signal)
legend.dropFromBestCp: cp drop vs the engine's #1 move at scan time (<=30 = engine-endorsed)
legend.pgnAfter: full move list including the novel move — paste into a board to view
legend.fenAfter: position after the novel move (opponent to move)
legend.oppBestReply: engine's best reply for the opponent (UCI)
